title: Listen to sprint planning and write the decisions (B1)
summary: Nghe cuộc họp lập kế hoạch sprint: ước lượng, chia nhỏ một việc quá lớn và cam kết số việc, rồi viết các quyết định.
learningObjectives: Nghe các con số ước lượng và lý do
Nhận ra quyết định chia nhỏ việc
Viết ghi chú kế hoạch sprint ngắn

turns.text: Let us look at the next story. It is the invoice export. Customers want to download all invoices in one file. Amir, how big is it?
I would say eight points. We need a new endpoint, a file builder and a progress screen. The file builder is the risky part because large accounts have thousands of invoices.
For testing, I would say five points. I need big test data and I need to check the file format with two accounting tools.
Eight points is a lot for one story. Can we split it?
Yes. We can do the endpoint and a small file first, for accounts under five hundred invoices. Then the progress screen and the large accounts in the next sprint. The first part is three points.
That works for me. Testing the small file is two points.
Good. So we commit to the first part in this sprint. Does the team still have room? Our capacity is twenty-four points.
We already have nineteen points. Five more brings us to twenty-four, which is exactly our limit, so I would not add anything else.
Agreed. We commit to twenty-four points and keep the large accounts for the next sprint. I will update the board and tell the customer about the two steps. Any questions? No? Thanks, everyone.

gist.question: What is the team doing?
gist.explanation: Họ ước lượng và chọn việc cho sprint.

detail.question: How big does Amir think the whole story is?
detail.explanation: Amir ước lượng tám điểm cho cả việc.

detail.question: Why do they split the story?
options: It is too large for one sprint
correctAnswer: It is too large for one sprint
detail.explanation: Jordan nói tám điểm là quá nhiều cho một việc.

detail.question: What does the first part include?
options: The endpoint and a small file
The progress screen and large accounts
correctAnswer: The endpoint and a small file
detail.explanation: Phần đầu dành cho tài khoản dưới năm trăm hóa đơn.

detail.question: How many points does the team commit to?
detail.explanation: Mười chín cộng năm bằng hai mươi tư.

listeningNotes.prompt: Ghi nhanh khi nghe; ghi chú không được lưu.

vocabulary.technicalMeaning: Đơn vị tương đối để ước lượng độ lớn của một việc.
vocabulary.example: We estimated the story at eight points.
vocabulary.commonMistake: Viết số trước point: three points.

vocabulary.technicalMeaning: Số công việc đội có thể làm trong một sprint.
vocabulary.commonMistake: Nhấn âm tiết thứ hai: ca-PAC-i-ty.

vocabulary.technicalMeaning: Tách một việc lớn thành các phần nhỏ hơn.
vocabulary.example: Can we split it into two parts?
vocabulary.commonMistake: Dạng quá khứ vẫn là split.

vocabulary.technicalMeaning: Đồng ý hoàn thành một lượng việc trong sprint.
vocabulary.commonMistake: Nói commit to + danh từ, không nói commit for.

vocabulary.technicalMeaning: Có khả năng làm chậm hoặc hỏng kế hoạch.
vocabulary.example: The file builder is the risky part.
vocabulary.commonMistake: Nói the risky part, không nói the risk part.

expressions.meaning: Nêu ước lượng và lý do.
expressions.example: I would say eight points because the file builder is risky.

expressions.phrase: Can we split it into ___ and ___?
expressions.example: Can we split it into a small file and the large accounts?
Our capacity is twenty-four points, so we should not add more.

expressions.phrase: We commit to ___ and keep ___ for next sprint.
expressions.example: We commit to twenty-four points and keep the large accounts for next sprint.

exercises.question: Which sentence explains an estimate?
options: I would say eight points because the file builder is risky.
Let us have lunch after the meeting.
The board is updated every Friday.
correctAnswer: I would say eight points because the file builder is risky.
exercises.explanation: Ước lượng đi cùng lý do.

exercises.question: Điền từ: We commit ___ twenty-four points.
Sắp xếp các bước của buổi planning.
options: Commitment: we commit to twenty-four points.
Capacity: we already have nineteen points.
Split: do the endpoint and a small file first.
correctAnswer: Split: do the endpoint and a small file first.
Capacity: we already have nineteen points.
Commitment: we commit to twenty-four points.
exercises.explanation: Ước lượng, chia nhỏ, kiểm tra năng lực, cam kết.

sections.title: Ôn lại từ vựng của bài

exercises.question: Ghép từ với nghĩa của nó.
exercises.explanation: Ôn lại các từ đã học trong bài này.

exercises.question: Điền từ còn thiếu (sức chứa của đội): Our ___ is twenty-four points.
exercises.explanation: "capacity" nghĩa là sức chứa của đội.

exercises.question: Điền từ còn thiếu (chia nhỏ): Can we ___ it into two parts?

performanceTask.title: Write sprint planning decisions
performanceTask.scenario: Sau buổi planning, bạn viết các quyết định để gửi cho đội và khách hàng.
performanceTask.baselinePrompt: Dựa vào ghi chú thô của một buổi planning, hãy viết các quyết định bằng tiếng Anh (60 đến 120 từ): ước lượng, việc được chia nhỏ và cam kết. Chưa xem bài mẫu.
performanceTask.performancePrompt: Write sprint planning notes in English, 60 to 120 words: the estimates, what was split and what the team committed to.
performanceTask.modelResponse: Sprint planning notes. The search filters story was estimated at 13 points by development and 8 points by QA. It was too large, so the team split it into basic filters (5 points) and saved filters (8 points). The capacity is 30 points and 22 are already committed. Basic filters bring the total to 27, so the team commits to them now. Saved filters move to the next sprint.
performanceTask.retryPrompt: Write the notes again in English. Keep the structure and make the numbers easier to find.
performanceTask.transferPrompt: Write notes for a different planning meeting, using estimates, a split and a commitment.
performanceTask.reviewPrompt: Write notes for another planning meeting without looking at old notes.

rubric.label: Estimates, split and commitment
rubric.description: The notes cover all three parts.

anchors.met: Estimates, the split and the final commitment are easy to find.
anchors.notMet: The commitment or the split is missing.

rubric.label: Accurate numbers and sentences
rubric.description: Numbers add up and the grammar is clear.

anchors.met: Numbers match and sentences are clear.

rubric.label: Planning vocabulary
rubric.description: Uses words such as estimate, capacity and commit.

anchors.met: Uses at least three planning words correctly.
anchors.notMet: Only everyday words such as "do" and "make".
